title: Taiwan Population Atlas
subtitle: Three decades of Taiwan, on a map
description: Play through population change across Taiwan’s 22 counties, compare their trends and explore household income. A 2017 hackathon project, rebuilt in 2026.
longDescription: An interactive atlas of population and household finances across Taiwan. Monthly population data starts in 1997, with annual income and savings indicators alongside it. A playback timeline, county comparison charts and shareable URLs turn the original 2017 Chiayi hackathon project into a tool for exploring change.
features: Population, migration, income and savings indicators
Animated timeline with adjustable playback speed
Compare trends across up to four counties
Government open data with reproducible conversion scripts
